Old '''Cully''' is a beggar in [[Ebou Dar]] and a high-ranking [[Darkfriend]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is gnarled, has only one eye and no teeth. He only washes once a year.

== Activities ==
He sends a number of Darkfriends, who are pretending to be beggars, to attack [[Matrim Cauthon]].
